_description: Phase 9 capability fixture: camera.look_at (aims at a specific point instead of a hand-typed rotation, verified against the 'Focus' sphere) plus depth-of-field (dof_enabled, f_stop, auto-derived focus_distance from the look_at target). 'Near' and 'Far' spheres are placed at clearly different camera distances (not just lateral offsets -- DOF blur is proportional to depth difference, not screen-space position, confirmed by an earlier test scene that had no visible blur because its three spheres were nearly equidistant from the camera).
